page: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v7 is a general-purpose server belonging to the Dadsv7 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 x86_64 processor featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores with 2 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It includes 3780 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in several key areas. The single-core CPU performance via stress-ng and the overall PassMark CPU score rank in the top 10%. Memory performance is also strong, with PassMark memory scores and database operations placing in the top 10%, supported by read-only cached memory bandwidth of 6649.6 GB/sec. Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks also achieve top-tier status. For machine learning workloads, LLM inference speeds for small and medium models reach top-tier and strong categories respectively, though performance drops to average when processing large 70B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D64ads_v7 offers a high-density resource profile, combining substantial compute power with a large local storage allocation and balanced memory capacity. This makes it highly suitable for database operations, high-throughput static web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference. It is also well-suited for heavy data processing workloads such as file compression, decompression, and multi-threaded computational tasks.
